rule: Every public number Jovie states is a stat here. Copy binds to it as {stat:<id>}; nothing else may write the number. Observations (measured values) live in the proof-stats/observations content record, written only by lib/proof-stats. A stat renders only while it is fresh, over its threshold, public, and (comparative or health) approved by the founder; otherwise the component hides or shows the fallback, never a stale or false number. Methodology: docs/proof/STATS.md.

stats.label: Artists and teams on Jovie

source.note: Non-deleted users whose account is external: users.account_class is null and the email fails the internal/test/synthetic/canary rules (externalAccountSql, lib/accounts/internal-account.ts).

stats.fallback: Built for artists and the teams behind them
stats.publicMethod: Accounts people created on Jovie. Team, test and automated accounts are excluded, and deleted accounts are not counted.

marketing.why: Social proof on the homepage and pricing. Live today; displays from 1,000.

stats.label: Artist profiles claimed

source.note: creator_profiles with is_claimed, excluding profiles owned by an internal account (notInternalProfileSql) and reserved identity handles. Unclaimed, ingested profiles never count.

display.sentence: {value} artists run their profile on Jovie

stats.publicMethod: Artist profiles that an artist or their team has claimed and runs. Profiles we prepared that nobody has claimed are not counted, nor are team or test profiles.

marketing.why: Artist-specific proof for /artist-profiles. Live today.

stats.label: Smart links created

source.note: Distinct (creator_profile_id, smart_link_slug) in smart_link_targets for profiles not owned by an internal account.

stats.publicMethod: Release and track links created on Jovie profiles, counted once per link. Links on team or test profiles are excluded.

marketing.why: Volume proof for release pages. Live today.

stats.label: Release alerts delivered

source.note: fan_release_notifications with status sent, for profiles not owned by an internal account.

stats.publicMethod: Release alerts sent to listeners who asked to hear about a release. Alerts from team or test profiles are excluded.

marketing.why: Outcome proof: Jovie does the release-day work. Live today.

stats.label: Profile server response, median

source.note: Median TTFB of the Jovie flagship profile across N rendered loads in the weekly Public Profile Benchmark (scripts/public-benchmark, hosted runner). A claim about Jovie alone.

display.sentence: Profiles start responding in under {value} ms

stats.publicMethod: Time until a public Jovie profile starts responding, the median of repeated page loads in our weekly benchmark.

marketing.why: Speed proof without naming anyone. Publishes only while the median stays under 200 ms.

stats.label: Profile agent-readiness score

source.note: Agent-readiness rubric score (0 to 100) of the Jovie flagship profile in the weekly Public Profile Benchmark.

stats.publicMethod: A 0 to 100 score for how well AI assistants can read a public Jovie profile: crawler access, readable HTML, structured data and machine interfaces. Measured weekly.

marketing.why: Positioning: profiles that AI assistants can read. Unique against link-in-bio tools.

stats.label: Profile load speed (LCP) against link-in-bio platforms

source.note: Median Lighthouse mobile LCP per platform flagship profile. Comparative: renders only when scripts/public-benchmark/claims.json marks profile-speed.lcp certified by the founder.

display.sentence: Profiles load faster than {value} measured link-in-bio platforms

stats.publicMethod: Largest contentful paint of a public profile on each platform, mobile, median of repeated loads. Shown only when Jovie is faster than every platform we could measure, by at least 10 percent.

marketing.why: The headline comparison. Needs every comparator measured (platform-a blocks the bench user agent, platform-b returns 403 to rendered loads) and a founder approval card.

stats.label: Profile page weight against link-in-bio platforms

source.note: Median total byte weight per platform flagship profile. Comparative and approval-gated like profile_lcp_rank.

stats.publicMethod: Total bytes downloaded to show a public profile on each platform, median of repeated loads. Shown only when Jovie is lighter than every platform we could measure, by at least 10 percent.

marketing.why: Supports the speed story on the spec grid.

stats.label: Agent-path certification checks passing

source.note: Passing checks over total in the agent-path certification (13/14 heading to 14/14). Producer: the weekly agent-readiness run (scripts/weekly-agent-readiness.mjs) posts passed/total.

stats.publicMethod: The checks an AI agent runs to create, claim and update a Jovie profile end to end. Shown only when every check passes.

marketing.why: Publish only at 14/14 (threshold 1.0): an all-pass claim, never a partial score.

source.note: Share of agent marketplace listing checks passing. The gate name is agent-distribution:ready; no script in main computes it yet (establish work).

marketing.why: Internal until listed in a marketplace.

stats.label: Open critical vulnerabilities

source.note: Count of open findings at critical severity after normalization (scripts/security/findings/normalize.mjs + policy.mjs) across Dependabot, code scanning and secret scanning. Aggregate only: no ids, packages, paths or dates are stored or published.

stats.publicMethod: Open security findings rated critical across dependency, code and secret scanning. Shown only when the count is zero.

marketing.why: Trust page. Publishes only at zero (ceiling 0): a non-zero count is never shown.

stats.label: Time to patch high and critical findings, median

source.note: Median hours from a high or critical finding opening to its fix merging, trailing 90 days. Aggregate only.
